stories.title: NOSS Compliance Validator — Automated Pre-Flight Checklist for All 20 CoCu Files
stories.description: Create Python script that validates all 20 CoCu markdown files against NOSS requirements: header table structure, assessment criteria presence, contact hour totals, K/P allocation compliance, required sections, and bilingual field presence. Output JSON compliance report with blocking issues highlighted.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_noss_compliance.py runs on all 20 content/IT-020-*/01_cocu-*.md files and outputs output/compliance_report.json with issues grouped by CoCu file, severity (blocking/warning), and requirement category
CLI command: uv run scripts/validate_noss_compliance.py --strict returns exit code 0 only if all blocking issues resolved
Report includes: total CoCu files (20), passing (N), failing (N), blocking issues count, warnings count, and checklist of 12 core NOSS requirements

stories.title: Bilingual Terminology Consistency Checker — Scan All CoCu Files for English/Bahasa Malaysia Terminology Matches
stories.description: Scan all 20 CoCu markdown files and extract key technical terms in English and Bahasa Malaysia columns. Flag inconsistencies where same concept uses different translations across files. Output HTML report with term frequency heatmap and suggested standardizations.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/check_terminology_consistency.py extracts all terms from 'Key Terms / Tools' sections across all 20 files and detects variant translations (e.g., 'motherboard' vs 'papan induk' used inconsistently)
Output file output/terminology_report.html shows 50+ technical terms with consistency score (0-100%), cross-file usage count, and suggested standardizations
Function extract_bilingual_terms(cocu_file) returns list of (english_term, malay_term, source_cocu) tuples for analysis

stories.title: Equipment EOL Tracker with Curriculum Impact Analysis — Flag Obsolete Technology in CoCu Hardware Components
stories.description: Create SQLite database of IT equipment with manufacturer end-of-life dates. Scan all CoCu files for equipment mentions and flag items approaching/past EOL. Generate curriculum impact report showing which CoCu units mention obsolete technology and recommend replacement specifications.
acceptanceCriteria: Database scripts/equipment_eol.db contains 100+ IT products (processors, RAM, storage, OS) with EOL dates; script scripts/audit_equipment_eol.py scans content/ for mentions and generates output/equipment_audit.json
Report includes: equipment name, EOL date, months-to-EOL status (green/yellow/red), list of CoCu files mentioning it, replacement recommendation
Function get_equipment_status(product_name) returns {status, eol_date, replacement_suggestion} for use in docx generator highlighting

stories.title: Bloom's Taxonomy Learning Outcome Analyzer — Classify All Learning Outcomes by Cognitive Depth
stories.description: Analyze all learning outcomes in every CoCu file. Classify each by Bloom's taxonomy level (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate, Create). Flag any CoCu with <20% Create-level outcomes as potential content gaps. Output taxonomy distribution report.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/analyze_bloom_taxonomy.py parses all 'Learning Outcomes' sections from 20 CoCu files using regex patterns for cognitive verbs (create, design, build → Create level; identify, describe → Remember level, etc.)
Output file output/bloom_taxonomy_report.json shows per-CoCu distribution: {cocu_id, total_outcomes, remember_pct, understand_pct, apply_pct, analyze_pct, evaluate_pct, create_pct, gaps_flagged}
Function classify_outcome(outcome_text) returns (verb, bloom_level, confidence_score) to enable outcome rewriting for depth improvement

stories.title: JPK Submission Readiness Aggregator — Pre-Flight Validation Dashboard for MySPIKE Upload
stories.description: Create web dashboard aggregating 15+ compliance checks (NOSS structure, bilingual titles, assessment criteria, contact hours, K/P allocation, equipment currency, learning outcome depth, references, practical exercises, contact hour math). Show pass/fail per check with blocking issue summary for submission readiness.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_jpk_dashboard.py reads output/compliance_report.json, output/bloom_taxonomy_report.json, output/equipment_audit.json and generates output/jpk_readiness.html

Dashboard displays: overall submission readiness % (0-100%), 15-item checklist with pass/fail status, blocking issues (red), warnings (yellow), passing checks (green), and estimated days-to-fix per blocking item
CLI: uv run scripts/generate_jpk_dashboard.py --output-dir output returns exit code 0 if readiness >= 95%, 1 if < 95%

stories.title: Instructor Facilitation Guide Generator — Auto-Generate Timing Budgets and Pedagogical Notes per CoCu
stories.description: Parse each CoCu's contact hour activity breakdown and generate HTML facilitation guide with: activity timing budget, common misconceptions per topic, formative assessment checkpoints, Q&A prompts, real-world scenario prompts. One guide per CoCu file.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_facilitation_guides.py reads contact hour distribution from each CoCu and outputs output/facilitation_guides/{cocu_id}_guide.html

Each guide includes: contact hour breakdown by activity type (lecture/practical/assessment %), estimated timing for each topic section, 3-5 common misconceptions per CoCu with remediation strategies, checkpoint questions (min 5 per CoCu)
Function generate_guide(cocu_content, cocu_id) returns HTML with embedded CSS ready for instructor download/printing

stories.title: Student Competency Portfolio SPA — Interactive Evidence Collection and Self-Assessment Tool
stories.description: Create single-page web app where students can map completed activities to learning outcomes, upload evidence (screenshots, work samples, reflections), and track competency progression across L3→L4→L5 pathway. Use localStorage for offline capability and generate exportable competency map PDF.
acceptanceCriteria: App output/portfolio_app.html uses vanilla JS + localStorage to track student progress; stores {cocu_id, learning_outcome_id, evidence_url, self_rating, date_completed, instructor_feedback}

Features: drag-and-drop evidence upload, 4-point competency scale (Novice→Advanced), visual pathway showing L3/L4/L5 skill chain, export-to-PDF competency map with completion date and evidence summary
API: POST /api/evidence stores student entry; GET /api/progress returns competency progression JSON for dashboard display

stories.title: Assessment Item Bank Generator — Create Bilingual Question Bank with Auto-Translation Validation
stories.description: Auto-generate formative assessment questions for each learning outcome across all 20 CoCu files. Create minimum 150 questions per level (450 total) with bilingual English/Bahasa Malaysia versions. Validate translations semantically to ensure meaning parity. Organize by Bloom's taxonomy level.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_assessment_items.py reads 'Learning Outcomes' from all 20 CoCu files and uses prompt-based generation to create output/assessment_items.json with {cocu_id, outcome_id, question_en, question_ms, bloom_level, answer_key, difficulty_estimate}
Validation: function validate_translation_parity(q_en, q_ms) checks semantic equivalence (>0.85 cosine similarity) and flags low-confidence translations for review
Output: minimum 150 items per level (L3/L4/L5) totaling 450+ questions, indexed by CoCu and Bloom level for filtering

stories.title: Knowledge/Performance Allocation Validator — Verify 30% Knowledge / 70% Performance Split Across All Work Activities
stories.description: Audit all 'Contact Hour Distribution' sections across 20 CoCu files. Verify that each work activity allocates 30% Knowledge and 70% Performance contact hours. Flag any deviations and suggest reallocation. Output corrective action plan with mathematical adjustments needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_kp_allocation.py parses contact hour distribution tables from all CoCu files and calculates K/P ratio per activity; output output/kp_validation_report.json shows {cocu_id, work_activity, hours_knowledge, hours_performance, kp_ratio, variance_from_30_70, status}
Function validate_allocation(activity_name, hours_k, hours_p) returns {is_compliant, variance_percentage, suggested_reallocation}; flags any activity with K/P ratio outside 25%-35% knowledge range
Summary: total hours audited (expect ~1200 L3 + L4/L5 hours), compliant activities count, non-compliant count, total hour reallocation needed to reach 30/70 target

stories.title: Contact Hour Activity Budget Tool — Break Down Hours by Activity Type with Timing Recommendations
stories.description: Parse each CoCu's contact hour distribution and create per-activity timing budget (lecture vs. practical vs. assessment breakdown). Generate recommendations for activity sequencing, pacing, and resource allocation. Output Excel spreadsheet with timeline template per level.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_activity_budgets.py reads contact hour distribution from all CoCu files and outputs output/activity_budgets.xlsx with sheets per level (L3/L4/L5) showing: activity name, total contact hours, recommended teaching days (assume 8 hrs/day max), weekly pacing, resource requirements

Each budget includes: activity sequencing recommendations (prerequisite dependencies), formative assessment checkpoints per activity, break distribution (15 min per 90 min session), practical vs. lecture ratio per week
Function get_activity_schedule(cocu_id, total_weeks_available) returns {schedule: [{week, activity, hours, resource_needs, checkpoint}]} for instructors to customize
